svg.title: Autocatalytic growth and compositional amplification
svg.desc: A dimensionless Frank-type closed-batch educational model compares kappa0 and4 from a=1,r=.0505,s=.0495,d=0. Autocatalysis alone preserves initial ee1%; mutual inhibition amplifies the free active-pool imbalance. The lower plot records free r+s. Exactly symmetric deterministic input retains ee0.
svg.metadata: {"kind": "review educational Frank-type closed-batch ODE", "equations": ["a_prime=-a*(r+s)", "r_prime=a*r-kappa*r*s", "s_prime=a*s-kappa*r*s", "d_prime=kappa*r*s"], "time": "tau=k*[A]_0*t", "concentrations": "normalized to initial substrate [A]_0", "initial": {"a": 1, "r": 0.0505, "s": 0.0495, "d": 0, "ee": 0.01}, "kappa": [0, 4], "dt": 0.005, "step_halving_max_abs_error": {"0": 1.2962964035523328e-12, "4": 2.177147351289932e-12}, "conservation": "a+r+s+2d=1.1", "theory_reference": "https://doi.org/10.1016/0006-3002(53)90082-1"}
